Added a regression test in [lifecycle_test.go](/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/copilotcli/lifecycle_test.go) that fails on the current behavior: a VS Code `Stop` payload with `stopReason:"end_turn"` must not produce a `session-end` event. I confirmed it failed before the fix.

Then I updated the VS Code compatibility validator in [compat.go](/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/copilotcli/compat.go) and [lifecycle.go](/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/copilotcli/lifecycle.go) so `Stop` is disambiguated by payload semantics:
- `agent-stop` accepts non-terminal `Stop` payloads like `stopReason:"end_turn"`
- `session-end` only accepts terminal `Stop` payloads, using `reason` or a non-`end_turn` `stopReason`
